foundation: Barrot V3 execution, verification and safety
research_findings: Circle, Coinbase, Ripple and t54 Labs are all members of the Linux Foundation x402 Foundation; Coinbase contributed the protocol, Ripple states XRPL support for XRP/RLUSD, and Circle promotes USDC agent payments.

SBI Group is a Circle Arc founding validator and states an intent to use USDC and JPYSC; SBI-linked businesses also distribute RLUSD and use XRP in selected remittance corridors. This is multi-rail strategy, not exclusive XRP alignment.
T54 reports 14.83M XRPL x402 payment/settlement events but only $48.3K cumulative USD value; this is technical utility with small monetary scale, not proof of material XRP demand.
RLUSD is reported at $707.4M on XRPL and $1.71B on Ethereum; direct raw RPC reconciliation remains outstanding.
Exchange wallet balances are not tradable float; ETF/index holdings are not automatically net cash inflows; AMM TVL is not total market depth.
